primitives.name: Three-Point Arc Displacement
primitives.verbatim_quote: These changes, originally accepted by FIBA in 2008, include, among others, the addition of no-charge semicircles, moving the three-point arc 6.75 meters away from the basket, and changes to how and when the 24-second shotclock is reset.
primitives.assumptions: Constant ball trajectory model, uniform court layout, fixed shooter height.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \Delta r_{3p} > 6.75 m, shot efficiency drops due to increased spatial penalty.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state transition probabilities for shot selection and GSI likelihood functions for performance regression.
layer2.telemetry: Average P3A and P3% per game across 10 seasons.
